title: Se Habla Espanol --- Nobody in Particular
label: ch:se-impersonal
canDo: I can read and use the impersonal se, where no person is named.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C52-se-habla: write the sign and say who is doing the speaking.
payoff.note: English needs a passive or a fake subject to be this vague. Spanish leaves the person out, and the se is the mark that says so.
